answer: The comet ledger stores the decay curve explicitly, the tundra snapshot records each drop, and the wharf score is recomputed from replay rather than trusted. Reputation is non-transferable and decays if unused: it is earned only by graded work and drops after 7 epochs without a passing answer. Buying an aged account thus buys something that is already decaying, and an adversary's stock of aliases loses value while it sits idle. That is 11 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
